text:
Update: a user named Miguel pulled a Shiny Steelix on Ripit before I caught my Shiny. He won the Heavy 1st Ed Base Set Pack ($30k+). 

We’re 10 hours in and at 1024 encounters 

Next person to pull a Shiny Pokemon in the Mega Rank on http://Ripit.co before I catch Shiny Onix will get this PSA 10 Mario Pikachu ($32.5k)
